item.title: Death on the road to Rafah: the night the IDF targeted World Central Kitchen aid workers
item.description: The Israeli army had helped plan the delivery of food aid on 1 April 2024, but things went wrong from the beginning and ended in seven deaths • Exclusive: why seven international aid workers were killed in Israeli airstrike On the evening of 1 April 2024, a team of aid workers from World Central Kitchen (WCK) stood on Gaza’s Mediterranean shore overseeing the unloading of a barge full of desperately needed food on a makeshift jetty made of sand and rubble. The Gaza war had been raging for six months and Israel’s closure of land crossings had left the whole territory facing the threat of… Fuente: The Guardian - World.
item.dc:creator: Julian Borger and Matan Cohen in Jerusalem

item.description: Exclusive: Guardian investigation reveals targeting of World Central Kitchen convoy was result of widely used military tactic • Death on the road to Rafah: the night the IDF targeted World Central Kitchen aid workers Seven aid workers killed in an airstrike in Gaza were marked as targets under an Israeli military practice of establishing guilt by association, a Guardian investigation shows. A top Israeli military prosecutor announced last month that he would not pursue criminal proceedings for the April 2024 incident in which drones fired missiles at three clearly marked World Central Kitchen… Fuente: The Guardian - World.

Sin embargo, posteriormente, el magistrado le dio al abogado de la defensa una hora para apelar. El abogado de la mujer sostuvo que la tragedia ocurrió mientras Clancy sufría psicosis posparto. item.description: Europa afronta una nueva fase de tensión con Rusia. Berlín investiga una serie de incidentes que incluyen supuestos sabotajes con drones, interferencias de GPS y ataques contra infraestructuras, mientras la Unión Europea y la OTAN denuncian una campaña de guerra híbrida rusa.
